hypotheses.construction_plan: Let L(x, y) = T(x, y) be a latent two-slot object. Specialize (x, y) to (i, j). The identity operator gives T(i, j). The permutation operator P acting as (P L)(x, y) = L(y, x) gives T(j, i). The raw expression is the symmetrized image L(i, j) + P L(i, j).
required_assumptions: T has two distinguishable ordered argument slots.
Permutation acts by swapping the two arguments.
proof_obligations: T(j, i) - P L(i, j) = 0, where (P L)(i, j) = L(j, i)
hypotheses.rationale: The expression is the sum over all permutations of two ordered indices, so the two non-identical terms are related by the S2 swap action on a single latent two-argument object.
